name: Short Cut Spicy "Taco Beef" Quesadilla with Fresh Salsa

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Once the skillet is hot, add oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add beef and cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes. Reduce heat to medium, add taco seasoning and water, then stir to combine. Simmer until sauce is reduced, about 1 min. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
8 oz lean ground beef
1 ½ tbsp taco seasoning

instructions.primary_message: Lay tortillas on a flat surface, divide beef and cheese between them, arranging on one half of each tortilla. Fold in half to close.
instructions.secondary_message: ⅔ cup shredded cheese, Mexican blend

instructions.primary_message: Wipe skillet clean with paper towel and set over medium heat; add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add quesadillas and cook, flipping halfway through, until cheese is melted and tortillas are golden on both sides, 5-6 minutes. Remove to a cutting board.
Cut each quesadilla into wedges and divide between plates. Serve with salsa on the side and enjoy!
